Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 16 Mar 2000 07:06:47 GMT, ravnos...@my-deja.com wrote:

>> Yes, one for each card. Virtually all effects in V:TES are cumulative
>> Army of Rats is the big exception.
>
>I don't want to start a big arguement here. But why not Army of Rats?

Original card intent. That, and think of it this way: get as many
small minions as you can with Animalism. Take a ton of actions to put
Armies in play. Watch your prey, and every successive prey you have,
be bled for 6-10 on YOUR untap, undeflectably. Smile and enjoy.

-- Derek
